observations.rationale: Exposure aggregation depends on upstream portfolio data quality. Reconciliation gaps between portfolio management and regulatory reporting taxonomies require manual mapping, adding 2-3 days per reporting cycle.

Submission preparation involves manual formatting across COREP and FINREP templates. Template changes by supervisory authority create periodic rework. Timeliness metric shows submissions at T-2 days average against T-5 day target.

Senior management attestation requires CRO sign-off on all regulatory submissions. Scheduling constraints occasionally delay final attestation by 1-2 days, though this has not caused a missed deadline.

bindingConstraint.justification: Data aggregation is the primary friction point in the Regulatory Reporting stream, though at moderate severity. The upstream data quality dependency creates the longest variable delay in the reporting cycle.
